machop_1.name: Machop
dialog: Ma-ma-MACHOP!

machop_2.name: Machop
dialog: Hrrngh... Chop! Choooop!

machop_3.name: Machop
dialog: Machop! Chop, chop!

guitarist.name: Guitarist
dialog: A Fossil is a letter from long, long ago, posted in rock.
The miners dig them up with the coal now and then.

camper.name: Camper
dialog: When I run with my Running Shoes on, I feel like the whole street is watching.
...It probably is. People who look your way sometimes want a battle.

battle_girl_1.name: Girl
dialog: Roark, the Gym Leader, is as often down the mine as in his Gym.
If the Gym is quiet, you know where to look.

battle_girl_2.name: Girl
dialog: When I feel fit and strong I can't stop smiling.
And when I'm smiling I feel fit and strong. It works both ways!

hiker.name: Hiker
dialog: East of here a mountain stands over everything: Mt. Coronet.
It cuts Sinnoh in two, right down the middle.

pokefan_f.name: Woman
dialog: The whole city is proud of its mine.
The galleries run out under the sea these days. Under the sea! Imagine it.

worker_1.name: Worker
dialog: These vents let the hot air out of the mine and the fresh air in.
Every time I look down one I want to shout hello.

worker_3.name: Worker
dialog: It's hard work, this. No two ways about it.
But with a Pokémon working beside you the day goes twice as fast.

worker_4.name: Worker
dialog: Our Gym Leader is young, but he's the mine's safety supervisor as well.
Knows his rocks, that one, in battle and out of it.
